events.name: Quick folder · scan workflow
events.scope: Common workflow: startup + scan/indexing + CSV export, no GUI rendering. File counts and scanner policies remain visible in the evidence.

events.name: Quick folder · 90th percentile completion
events.scope: Common startup + scan + CSV export. R-7 interpolated p90; at least 10 valid repetitions per product. Small-sample tail estimate, not a worst-case guarantee. Live-disk differences remain.

events.name: Quick folder · timing variability
events.scope: Common startup + scan + CSV export. Interquartile range / median × 100; lower means more consistent, not faster. At least 10 valid repetitions; uncontrolled caches and live-disk changes affect spread.

events.name: Quick folder · peak memory
events.scope: Same synthetic dataset and startup + scan + CSV export boundary; median of sampled resources. At least 3 valid samples per product; short-run missing samples remain missing.
